quote: Two hundred seven Cornell University undergraduates participated in exchange for either a piece of candy or as part of an experimental session for which they received extra credit in their psychology or human development classes. The data from six participants, three in the P17 condition and three in the P97 condition, were excluded because their responses fell outside of the allowable range of 0–100.
reason: Study 2 recruited 207 undergraduates and excluded 6 for out-of-range responses, leaving an analytic sample size of 201 for the critical Welch's t-test (t(197.5) = 2.12). The shipped value of 207 reflects the pre-exclusion recruited total (also repeated in the Many Labs 2 summary) rather than the post-exclusion analytic N.
